title: Out of chips
blurb: They can't call. Make the lie count.
say: Black has no chips, so Black can't call your claims, and can't pay for a showdown either. Your card on a1 is really a knight. Checkmate in one move.
explain: Claim Rook (or Queen) and slide to a8. On the apparent board that's a back-rank mate. Black could only escape by calling or by exposing your card in a showdown, and both cost a chip Black doesn't have.
hint: A knight can't mate from there, but a card can claim to be anything that reaches the back rank.
